title_zh: 海关查验 / Hold 与费用钟
title_en: Customs hold / exam vs fee clocks

why_attention.summary_zh: 查验与费用钟。近 90 天宽查询抽样 ≥24；严格 customs exam/storage 仅约 7。近 7 天 counts 宽 6 / storage 10。

definitions.def: Cargo held for inspection, docs, or security — dwell increases.
May include terminal handling to exam site, gov fees, demurrage/storage while waiting — parties vary by country.
Demurrage/detention/storage timers that may keep running during hold unless tariff/waiver says otherwise.

who_pays.typical: Often consignee/importer on destination exam; origin exam may hit shipper — Incoterms & local practice decide. Not a single global rule.

common_pitfalls: Missing packing-list vs load-plan mismatch that triggers exam.
No named contact path in Port Pack checklist.

official_sources.note: Argues free time should reflect periods merchant cannot act (principle, not universal law)
Negotiate extension when terminal cannot release

country_hooks.note: Customs exam + packing list align checklist

faq.q: 查验时 demurrage 停不停？
faq.a: 多数不自动停。能否减免看船司/码头条款、当地惯例与协商。Globe 标「待核实/合约」。
Checklist：谁联系海关/船司/码头、证据留存、并行时钟提示——不是自动免单引擎。

disclaimer: Not legal advice. Commercial fees ≠ administrative fines. Amounts require source URL + as_of. X evidence is heat/wording only.
